This is a test fixture for Ghost Whisper transcription testing.

The audio file (sample-speech.wav) contains synthetic audio with varying frequencies
(200 Hz for 2 seconds, then 400 Hz for 2 seconds) at 16 kHz sample rate, mono channel.

This fixture is used to verify that:
1. The Deepgram nova-3 model is correctly configured
2. Audio injection via virtual audio device works
3. Transcription pipeline processes audio without errors

Expected transcription accuracy: This synthetic audio will not produce meaningful speech
transcription. The reference is provided for baseline comparison and to verify the
transcription pipeline completes without errors.

For real speech testing, replace this file with actual recorded speech samples.
